question: Name the famous hockey player after which there is a stadium built in New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Dhyan Chand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium** is located in New Delhi, India, and is named after the legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand is considered one of the greatest field hockey players of all time.
 
• He was known for his extraordinary goal-scoring feats and earned the nickname "The Wizard" for his superb ball control.
 
• Dhyan Chand won three Olympic gold medals in field hockey in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**
 
 
• Born - 29 August 1905
 
• Died - 3 December 1979
 
• Position - Center Forward
 
• Olympic Medals - 3 (Gold)
